purpose: Test a smooth generalized additive model with learned pair interactions as a complementary risk model
features: Existing denoised Kumo feature set; deterministic latent proxies, no IDs or outcome-time features
balance: For the balanced variant, positive sample weight n_negative/n_positive is computed only from this outer-training fold. Restore the population prior before probability blending.
baseline: Public 0.56393 Kumo-spline recipe on matching five OOF folds
selection_limitations: Repeated research reuses training labels and folds. This is not an untouched holdout.
